description: ecoinvent 3.13, released 2026-11-04, is registered and merged ahead of 3.12. The rows 3.13 re-registers are stated under their own issues: the endosulfan isomers (#456), propyl propionate (#457) and the five organotins (#458). Here, first, the seven corrections 3.13 ships itself -- Strontium II, Caesium I, the three lindane isomers, Molybdenum VI and the dinitrogen number on Nitrogen, organic bound -- still land where the corrected 3.12 rows land, now with no fix stated for 3.13. Third, the rows 3.13 retires and renames are accounted for. Measured against the five-list build of 5f06833, where all twenty-one endosulfan rows of 3.12 sat on one substance and 3.12's propyl propionate row was published as ethyl methyl carbonate.

expectations.title: ecoinvent 3.13's thirteen `Strontium II` rows reach `Strontium(2+)` with no correction stated
expectations.comment: 3.12 needed a fix from 7440-24-6, the metal, to 22537-39-9; 3.13 ships the ion's number, and its fixes file states nothing about the rows. The merge records the thirteen rows under the ion's spelling, `Strontium(2+)`, which is what the selector names.

expectations.title: ecoinvent 3.13's five `Caesium I` rows reach `Caesium(1+)` with no correction stated
expectations.comment: 3.13 ships 18459-37-5, the number the 3.12 fix supplied.

expectations.title: ecoinvent 3.13's thirteen `Molybdenum VI` rows reach `Molybdenum(6+)` with no correction stated
expectations.comment: 3.13 ships 16065-87-5, the ion's number, which 3.10.1 to 3.12 had to be corrected to (#181). Selected by the ion's spelling, as the merge records the rows.

expectations.title: The ecoinvent `Alpha-lindane` row to unspecified air lands on the alpha isomer, 319-84-6, from 3.12 and 3.13 alike
expectations.comment: 3.11 and 3.12 wrote gamma-lindane's 58-89-9 on the alpha, beta and delta rows and are corrected (#26); 3.13 writes each isomer's own number. Selected by uuid, since the merge records the row under the substance's name.

expectations.title: ecoinvent 3.13's five `Nitrogen, organic bound` rows reach `Nitrogen, Organic Bound`, not dinitrogen
expectations.comment: 3.13 ships the rows with no registry number, which is what the 3.12 fix did; it still writes the synonyms `dinitrogen` and `molecular nitrogen` on them, and the 3.13 fixes file still removes those (#57).

expectations.title: ecoinvent 3.13's two `Allyl alcohol` rows reach `Allyl Alcohol`, where 3.12's `2-Propen-1-ol` rows also sit
expectations.comment: 3.13 retires the seven `2-Propen-1-ol` rows, 107-18-6, and keeps the two `Allyl alcohol` rows under the same number with `2-Propen-1-ol` as a synonym. The merge already put both names on one substance.

expectations.title: ecoinvent 3.13's `Sodium stearyl fumarate` row creates its own substance, 4070-80-8, rather than landing on fumaric acid
expectations.comment: On the build of 68894af the row, which carries 4070-80-8, was matched by its vendor synonym `Fumaric acid` to EF 3.1's `fumaric acid`, 110-17-8, because no list carries the ester's number and the label matcher reads synonyms. The synonym is removed by the 3.13 fixes file. Met on the six-list build of 4198d4c, where each ester creates its own substance.

expectations.title: ecoinvent 3.13's `Monostearyl fumarate` row creates its own substance, 1741-93-1, rather than landing on fumaric acid
expectations.comment: The same defect on the second ester, through the same synonym, measured on the same build. Met on the six-list build of 4198d4c, where each ester creates its own substance.

expectations.title: The fumaric acid substance carries EF 3.1's thirteen rows and no ecoinvent 3.13 ester
expectations.comment: On the build of 68894af the substance carried fifteen flows: EF 3.1's thirteen and the two ester rows above. Met on the six-list build of 4198d4c, where each ester creates its own substance.
